shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated geometric marks
justification: The most specific overlap is that both include avian/profile forms and bands of repeated linear marks, rendered with outline and internal incision-like detailing. The biggest difference is that A is organized around large standing anthropomorphic figures with garments, wings, hands, and held objects, while B is a schematic field of separate animals and abstract signs arranged in registers without the same figure-to-figure scene or attributes.
